document.abstract: The Flutter Measuring Set was built to measure the low percentage flutter of present-day recording and reproducing equipment. The set conforms to the “Proposed Standard Specifications for Flutter or Wow as Related to Sound Records,” as outlined in the Society's Journal for August, 1947, pp. 147–159.
